summary: Handheld cloud-shaped virtual pet: FDM two-piece shell holding a XIAO ESP32-S3, a Grove 1.2in 240x240 IPS display, a LiPo cell and three tactile buttons.

required_interfaces.description: 40x40 mm display board seated behind a window exposing the 24.76x26.8 mm screen
XIAO ESP32-S3 USB-C reachable through the shell for charging and flashing
Three domed caps pressing 6x6 mm tactile switches
U-shaped 60x26x1.6 mm key PCB, top at shell Z13.5; replace switch clips and shorten underlying posts before assembly.

external_references.description: Reference photo of a lobed handheld pet with square screen and three buttons
Cloud icon whose bumpy outline the shell edge follows
Seeed XIAO ESP32-S3 wiki (dimensions, pin map)
Seeed Grove 1.2-inch IPS Display wiki (screen and board size)

assembly_story.installation: Display and buttons sit in the front shell, XIAO and battery in the back shell; the halves close with screws from the back.
assembly_story.maintenance: Remove the back screws to replace the battery.

designs.description: Cloud-lobed two-piece shell with screen window, bezel and button caps
